source: callback-return 표시는 어떤 후속 작업보다 앞서며, 무엇의 완료를 추적하지 않습니까?
prior_translation: The callback-return marker precedes any follow-up work, and it does not track completion of what?
validated_native_translation: Which subsequent operations does the callback-return marker precede, and what completion does it not track?
